notes: Modified cash basis village, extracted as FY2024. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5); no transfers printed. Roll-forward 1,675,162 + 892,986 - 504,641 = 2,063,507. Business-type (Electric, Water, Sewer) from the proprietary statement Total column (p7): 728,455 + 817,915 - 769,168 = 777,202; nonoperating 'Capital outlay' (6,200) recorded as a disbursement (Sewer). Business-type 'Other revenue' is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (817,160, p2), so charges for services. Proprietary cash flow statement (pp8-9) printed but proprietary left null as in FY2024 (cash basis). ending_cash = governmental funds cash + county treasurer cash (p4); no beginning governmental cash printed. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4, totals equal government-wide), business-type lines and totals from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Detail: General Fund from the General Fund departments combining statement (pp14-15; ties to 294,119 / 269,533); the General Fund budget schedule (p10) is the less detailed duplicate and is not recorded. Street and Community Development Agency budget schedules (pp11-12; zero-actual Capital outlay and Transfers lines not recorded), nonmajor combining statement (p13, Keno and Debt Service funds). Proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule, so no business-type detail (as FY2024). Read pages 1-15 of 15.
